summary: Exchange expired DataLab seats and align annual renewal for Research Platform
description:
Issue summary: Research Platform (R&D) team noticed 12 DataLab SaaS seats expired during a recent onboarding drive. Request covers exchanging expired seats, purchasing additional seats for new hires, and aligning the contract renewal date to Redwood's fiscal cycle.

Background: DataLab is a lightweight analytics notebook vendor used by several research teams for ephemeral workloads. Purchasing was handled previously by a different cost center and the contract renewal process was inconsistent; seats have lapsed and some users lost access mid-project. The Research Platform lead asked Procurement to centralize future billing and set a single annual renewal.
impact: 12 users across Research Platform and Applied ML lost access to DataLab notebooks mid-sprint, interrupting experiments. Short term impact: blocked reproducibility and demo prep for customer-facing evaluation. Medium term: team may request alternative tooling or escalate for emergency seat grants. No customer-facing SLA breach yet, but continued disruption could delay deliverables to product teams.
steps_to_reproduce: Team attempted to log into DataLab and received 'seat not assigned' error
Admin console shows 12 seats in 'expired' status and license renewal date 2026-03-15 in previous vendor account
Attempted to request temporary seat via DataLab support portal but vendor requires PO/updated billing contact before reactivation
logs: Vendor portal screenshot and billing invoice attached in ticket (refer to Confluence page for attachments). Vendor portal ticket ID: DL-489302. Finance notes: previous PO #PO-2023-149 marked to cost center research-old. No signed SOW on file for 2025–2026 period.
comments: 2026-02-20 10:14 - Aisha Khan: Opening ticket after email from Priya R. (Research Platform). Priya attached a list of affected users and time-sensitive experiments. Requesting seat reactivation + reconcile billing to RD-WORKLOADS cost center.

2026-02-20 14:02 - Marcus Liu: Assigned to Procurement. I'll start by contacting DataLab account rep and pulling last year's contract. Adding Legal for updated T&Cs.
Action: confirm whether vendor allows mid-term seat exchange vs. full invoice reissue.

2026-02-21 09:31 - Elena Ortiz (Legal): Reviewed prior contract. There is a clause for mid-term additions but vendor requires signed amendment and updated PO. We'll need an approval from Finance for accelerated payment terms if seats activate before renewal alignment.

2026-02-22 16:40 - Finance (R. Gomez): Can cover one-off seat purchases under inter-department recharge. Need estimated cost per seat from vendor to route PO. If we align renewal to fiscal year, we may negotiate slight pro-rated credit for existing expired seats.

2026-02-25 11:05 - Marcus Liu: DataLab rep (Samir) confirmed: can reactivate 12 seats upon receipt of PO and signature on amendment; offering pro-rated pricing if renewal date moved to 2026-04-01. Vendor requests official contact and tax info for Redwood legal entity. Preparing draft amendment and PO.

2026-02-26 09:20 - Priya R. (Research Platform): Confirmed list of users and urgency — two experiments complete next week. Requested temporary access keys if vendor process will delay beyond 48 hours.
investigation_notes:
Procurement action items: 1) Pull copy of last signed contract and verify pricing band. 2) Confirm vendor's ability to pro-rate expired seats and shift renewal to 2026-04-01. 3) Prepare PO template referencing amendment; coordinate with Legal for signature. 4) Update Identity Management to assign seats once vendor confirms reactivation.
Findings: Past vendor contact info found in internal vendor registry (vendor_id: VEND-211). Prior PO referenced research-old cost center; need cost-center transfer to RD-WORKLOADS. No open SSO or SCIM integration changes required; DataLab supports both SAML and SCIM but SCIM provisioning was not enabled on previous account.
resolution_notes: Pending - in progress. Current plan: Draft amendment and PO created 2026-02-26 and sent to DataLab rep (Samir). If vendor signs and issues invoice within 24–48 hours, Procurement will route PO to Finance for payment and notify Identity Management to reassign seats. Long-term: move DataLab billing and renewal to RD-WORKLOADS cost center and enable SCIM provisioning to automate seat assignment. Follow-up task: INT-16812 (create SCIM onboarding checklist for DataLab).
next_steps: 1) Finalize amendment and PO; 2) Finance approval of inter-department recharge; 3) Send signed paperwork to vendor; 4) Confirm seat reactivation and verify access for affected users; 5) Open a follow-up ticket for SCIM provisioning and renewal alignment.
